plate: Chapman, Architectura Navalis Mercatoria (1768), Pl. LVIII, No. 17 "Algerisk Chebeque"
units: metres; X fwd of AP, Z above plate baseline, Y half-breadth from centreline

calibration.vertical_scale: no vertical scale bar on the plate; vertical assumed equal to horizontal (checked: body-plan draught and profile draught agree within 2 px)
calibration.scan_rotation: none measurable: 20 station lines and both perpendiculars are vertical in the scan to |dx/dy| <= 0.004 (median 0.001). The engraved scale bars slope dy/dx = -0.0075 and the dashed baseline slopes -0.00247; both are engraving/printing, not scan rotation.
calibration.baseline: plate dashed baseline, y = -0.002473*x + 1149.082 px (y=1147.78 at AP, 1141.12 at FP). It is tangent to the underside of the keel near midship, i.e. Z=0 = underside of keel at its lowest point. The keel bottom is drawn rockered: it rises toward both ends (see profile.keel_bottom).

LWL.note: LWL is not parallel to the baseline: drawn with drag (deeper aft).

provenance.scale_bar: S bar ticks detected as grey minima along the bar centre row (y=367.7 at x=420, slope -0.0075); 30 ticks 0..30 ft fitted linearly, rms 0.56 px; zero at x=408.99
provenance.AP_FP: grey-centroid of the dashed/solid perpendicular in every row y=700..1140, robust linear fit, x at y=1000 (AP n=382 rows, FP n=251 rows)
provenance.baseline: grey-centroid of the dashed baseline in columns 540..999 and 2950..3199 (clear of the keel), linear fit, 399 columns
provenance.LWL: grey-centroid of the LWL in every 2nd column x=600..3148, linear fit with 1.5 px outlier rejection, 1213 columns

keel_depth.provenance: profile at x=1878 px: baseline (=keel bottom) to the upper thin line (top of keel/rabbet) = 15.9 px; body plan: dashed baseline y=773.14 to rabbet line y=753.00 = 20.1 px

tip_of_carved_figure.method: rightmost ink pixel in box x3550-3760, y640-740 (carved figure at beak end)

beak.provenance: per column: first ink (upper outline) and last ink (lower outline) in y640..860; right of x~3330 the No.18 drawing intrudes below y~850. Only columns x>=3440 px (beyond the stem head and clear of the No.18 drawing) are reported; between FP and x=3440 the beak overlaps the stem-head structure and the outline was not separated (not measured).

aft_tip_of_platform_rail.method: leftmost column in x100..260 having >=3 ink pixels in y470..600 (end of balustraded stern platform rail); y = centre of that ink

aft_tip_of_awning_spar.method: leftmost ink pixel in box x60-200, y420-460 (awning/outrigger spar over stern platform)

stern_platform.deck_floor: not separated on the plate from the balustrade (not measured)
stern_platform.provenance: per column x: [x, spar centre y (first ink), rail top y (first thick run >15 px below the spar), underside y (last ink in y470..700)]; rail top = linear fit to per-column rail-top runs (balusters rejected as >8 px outliers)

quarterdeck.status: NOT MEASURED in this pass (time); quarterdeck bulwark with rectangular openings spans roughly x=533..947 px on the plate (earlier agent); no pixel trace by this agent

ports.provenance: closed rectangles found from horizontal ink runs (13-21 px = oar port, 40-52 px = gun port) in rows 786..856 that recur at top and bottom of the same x-span and have side strokes; top/sill = outer edge rows of the frame lines (outside of the ink)
ports.missing: Only 2 of the 8 waist gun ports were found automatically: on the other 6 the port top merges with the rail-band line, so the top edge run is longer than 52 px and the detector rejected them. Not measured here.

main.provenance: mast-stub side edges (ink runs <=5 px) on rows 700 and 760 px: [[700, 1786.5, 1830.5], [760, 1786.5, 1830.0]]

fore.provenance: mast-stub side edges (ink runs <=5 px) on rows 640 and 700 px: [[640, 3014.5, 3046.0], [700, 3010.5, 3042.0]]

body_plan.Z_datum: body-plan dashed baseline = underside of keel (keel drawn 2116..2133 px wide, rabbet line at y=753.0)
body_plan.which_half: LEFT half = AFT body (sections cross the left diagonal at labels 4..16 = numbered stations, which are aft of midship in the profile); RIGHT half = FORE body (labels D..P = lettered stations forward).
body_plan.flare: all sections flare strongly outward above the LWL; the midship section reaches the rail cap far outboard of the waterline breadth (see largest Y of the outermost sections)
body_plan.labelling_caveat: labels are assigned by ORDER from the outside (midship first). The tracer found fewer distinct curves than the plate has sections and some merged groups may combine two neighbouring sections; check body_plan overlay before using a label.
